text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Quietly, very quietly...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mirako-chan, what's the matter? If 
you're looking for the restroom, it's the 
other way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Gulp...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
P-Please, let me off the hook! Anything 
but the pool, have mercy...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But in the 'U.A.F.', you get 
disqualified if you don't record a score 
in every event...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, just a little bit! Won't you summon up 
your courage? Come on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if I'm disqualified~! If it 
means getting into the pool, I'd rather 
just drop out of the U.A.F....!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Sheesh, I can't bear to watch this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Top Road's saying that for your own good, 
you know? She can't just abandon a pal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. After all, I want everyone to do 
their best together right to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I am grateful for that, but...! 
Still...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi. Top Road's playin' the bad guy for 
your sake."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Quit with the half-assed whining— make up 
your damn mind, too.
(Glare...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
N-Now, now! Pokke-chan, that's enough. If 
you glare like that, you'll terrify 
Mirako-chan—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even so... this is the one thing I won't 
back down on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I hate getting scolded by Pokke-chan, but 
I hate the pool even more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I won't! No matter what anyone says! I'm 
neeeever getting into the pool!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Glaring right back at me... just 
how much do you hate the pool?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
But... you've got some serious guts! I 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh... really? Then since you like me so 
much, how about letting me off the hook 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No, that's exactly why... let's do diving! 
You're definitely cut out for it, trust 
me!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"See, this is a test of pure grit! First 
one to lift their head loses!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see! So it's suited for someone 
with guts like Mirako-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh...... Whaaaaat!!? No way, no way, I 
don't have that kind of grit~!
